thread:
maria: Heads up, two staging snapshot restores failed with decrypt errors. Restore-agent: "KMS Decrypt failure: UnauthorizedOperation". No key-policy edits in the last 24h but we did rotate uploader roles overnight.

lee: Which CMK? any grant TTL alerts?

maria: Key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333444555666:key/ghi-789-klm. Sec-bot flagged a grant expiry earlier: `kms-grant-expiry grant=G-30303 key=ghi-789-klm principal=arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/data-uploader ttl=2025-03-04T03:10:00Z`

sec-bot: [info] CloudTrail shows CreateGrant failed at 03:05:12Z with InvalidPrincipal for arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/new-data-uploader.

oliver: Looks like the grant-rotator tried renewing while infra was renaming the role -> race. list-grants shows leftover grant pointing to old role.

maria: Pasted output: `aws kms list-grants --key-id ghi-789-klm` -> Grants includes G-30303 grantee arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/old-data-uploader.

oncall-ops: I can create a temp grant to unblock restores. Need approval from sec.

lee: Approve for immediate mitigation. Also ensure temp grant is short-lived and documented.

oliver: Creating temp grant now: `aws kms create-grant --key-id ghi-789-klm --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/new-data-uploader --operations Decrypt --name temp-restore-grant` -> GrantId G-40404 (expiry 2025-03-04T05:00:00Z).

oncall-ops: Running restore smoke: `./bin/restore-check --env=staging --snap=snap-20250303` -> `decrypt part-0001: ok` -> restore complete.

maria: Immediate outage mitigated. Root cause: race between role rename and grant-rotator plus lack of principal-existence precheck.

lee: Follow-ups: 1) Add principal existence check to grant-renewer; 2) Add preflight to role-rename playbook to rebind grants; 3) Alert when grants reference non-existent principals >2m. Create tickets ENG-4520 (rotator), ENG-4521 (playbook), ENG-4522 (alerting).

sec-bot: Created ENG-4520, ENG-4521, ENG-4522 and scheduled a 30m sync. Will auto-open if similar patterns appear.

oliver: Also recommend adding a periodic scan that lists grants and cross-checks IAM for stale principal ARNs; low-risk run weekly.

maria: Good call. Adding to backlog and closing staging incident. Thanks all.
